resale_co.name: Certificate of continued occupancy (Certificate of Resale / Rental Compliance)
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Helmetta Code Enforcement (Code Enforcer / Fire Marshal)
requirements: Smoke alarms on all levels including attic spaces and basements; 10 year sealed battery or hardwired interconnected, less than 10 years old
Smoke and CO alarms within 10 feet of all sleeping areas (the resale packet copy says CO alarms less than 7 years old; the separate checklist says less than 10)
Walls, floors and ceilings in good condition, no holes
Working kitchen and bathrooms: hot and cold water with shut-off valves, drain traps, toilets secured with shut-off valve
Outlets, junction boxes and electrical equipment working with cover plates; panel openings closed; service cable secured
Water heater, boiler, furnace and HVAC working and vented; replacements must have a construction permit
Fireplaces, wood stoves and chimneys maintained
Exit doors working; no double keyed deadbolts (thumb-latch locks)
Windows operate; no broken panes or torn or missing screens
Gutters, leaders, roof and foundation in good repair
No extension cords used as permanent wiring (garage door openers, sump pumps and appliances plugged directly into outlets)
House numbers at least 4 inches high, visible from the curb; handrails on stairs with 3 or more risers
Yard maintained; pools protected with fences and self-closing, self-latching gates

fees.label: Certificate application (resale)
fees.quote: PLEASE COMPLETE TOP PORTION AND RETURN WITH CHECK FOR $100.00 PAYABLE TO THE BOROUGH OF HELMETTA

resale_co.how_to_apply: Complete the top of the Borough Application for Certificate (block/lot, owner, selling price, closing date, requested by owner or agent) and return it with a $100.00 check payable to the Borough of Helmetta, 51 Main Street, Helmetta. The smoke/CO application is a separate form with its own fee. Realtors are asked to give the Resale and Rental Inspection Checklist to the homeowner before the inspection.

evidence.quote: PLEASE COMPLETE TOP PORTION AND RETURN WITH CHECK FOR $100.00 PAYABLE TO THE BOROUGH OF HELMETTA
Certification Expires 90 days after issue date
This serves notice that based on a general inspection of the visible parts of the building there are no imminent hazards and the building is approved for continued occupancy.

Housing Inspections are required in accordance with the Uniform Fire Code of the State of New Jersey, Helmetta Borough Ordinance for all persons who sell, rent or transfer ownership, change occupants of a residence - home, townhouse, condo, apartment, and must have a smoke detector, carbon monoxide detector, and fire extinguisher compliance test performed before any closing is executed.
All open construction permits shall be finalized before a Certificate of Resale / Rental Compliance will be issued.
Realtors and Agents shall give a copy of these checklists to the homeowner to ensure compliance at time of inspection
LEAID: 1206-001 Enf Auth. Fire Dept Fire Official George Wallace Phone (732) 521-4946 Email G.Wallace@HelmettaBoro.com

resale_co.notes: The Borough Building Dept. forms page posts an Application for Certificate (Code Enforcement / Construction Department, January 2025 scan) that asks for the selling price and closing date, charges $100.00 and issues a certificate approving continued occupancy, valid 90 days. The Borough Code Enforcement Information sheet (January 2026) says housing inspections are required by Borough ordinance for everyone who sells or transfers ownership. The ordinance text itself was not found online, so confidence is medium. The Borough resale and rental checklist refers to a "Certificate of Resale / Rental Compliance". Construction permits for Helmetta are handled by the NJ DCA construction office at Jamesburg Borough Hall (732-521-2222 ext. 106, Mondays and Wednesdays 8:30 AM to 12:00 PM). The contact page shows no email; the email is from the state fire directory. There is a separate rental smoke detector application (2020) with rental fees; it is not a resale item.

requirements: Smoke alarms: 10 year sealed battery type or hardwired interconnected, less than 10 years old, on all levels including attics and basements
CO alarms within 10 feet of all sleeping areas (less than 7 years old per the resale packet checklist)

The Borough resale smoke/CO form (January 2025) and fire checklist still list a fire extinguisher; they were written before P.L.2025, c.19 removed the state extinguisher requirement, so confirm with the Fire Marshal

authorities.how_to_apply: Fill out the Property Resale Residential Smoke Detector, Carbon Monoxide Detector, Fire Extinguisher Compliance Application (Building Dept. forms page) and submit it with a check payable to "BOROUGH OF HELMETTA" to the Bureau of Fire Prevention, 51 Main Street. Payment must be received before an inspection is scheduled. Questions: Fire Marshal, 732-521-4946 ext. 109.

fire_cert.notes: The DCA registry lists Helmetta as fire department enforced (code F); the Borough Bureau of Fire Prevention / Fire Marshal (George Wallace) runs the smoke/CO certificate. Fees are from the Borough Property Resale form scanned January 13, 2025. The state directory also lists a second Helmetta fire department page (an industrial brigade at a Princeton address), which is not a resale inspecting agency.
